data.gender_notes: Asyam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Asa’ meaning ‘to help’ or ‘to support’. This name holds significant spiritual meaning in Islam, symbolizing one’s commitment to help and support others. The name Asyam carries the meaning “Help or Support” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asyam usually hope their child will grow to embody help or support and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of support and commitment in Islam.
data.etymology: Asyam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help or Support.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asyam total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Overall, this name reflects the Islamic belief in the interconnectedness of all beings and the importance of living a life of generosity and compassion towards others.
